status: Current revision2026-11-05 governs shared healthy/injured inspection; historical top-level contracts retained for provenance.
owner: Game Mechanics specification; Engineering runtime; Art and audio supplied separately
approved_presentation: Spare Employee Dispenser: injured hero compressed and thrown at screen; bloody cartoon SPLAT with X-eyed dead hero sliding down and leaving fading blood trail; intact same-hero clone emerges. BJ silent first use.

timing.clock: Independent presentation elapsed time, advancing while gameplay is frozen. Explicit player Pause suspends presentation and deadlines; all limits measure active control-lock time, excluding time voluntarily paused.
timing.watchdog: At deadline call the same safe finalizer as skip, regardless of missing animations/audio/events. Never await audio completion. All animation states advance from elapsed time and/or validated events.

trigger.requirement: Living hero, not already in interaction/death/dialogue/menu; enter an armed dispenser trigger.
trigger.checkpoint_order: Commit only a new higher checkpoint index. Never regress progress by touching an older dispenser.
trigger.repeat_use: Preserve current one-time checkpoint activation behavior: already activated dispenser does not repeatedly heal. Rearm-on-exit alone does not grant another heal.
trigger.rearm: Consume entry latch immediately; rearm only after hero fully exits trigger, including after skip/respawn. Mark current activated index ineligible independently.
trigger.priority: Resolve pending lethal damage/death first; a zero-HP hero cannot start injured check-in. Never interrupt the intro/dialogue or existing death sequence.
trigger.geometry: Preserve first-crossing thresholds x3300,6660,8190. Decorative machine adds no solid obstacle. Resolve preexisting lethal damage first; capture pre-heal health and mode before commit.

state_machine.ready: Await eligible entry; snapshot hero ID and interaction mode. Consume latch before side effects.
state_machine.healthy_stamp: Health equals selected hero max. Commit checkpoint and stamp; release within0.5s. No destruction or life change.
state_machine.scan: Injured living entry. Commit checkpoint and full healing immediately at0.0s, before comedy. Protect hero and pause encounter simulation. Scan0.0–0.4s.
state_machine.compress: 0.4–1.4s grab/cartoon compression; presentation only, not gameplay death.
state_machine.throw_impact: 1.4–2.1s throw toward screen, blood splatter and synchronized impact SPLAT. Show X-eyed dead cartoon hero as presentation only, no life loss.
state_machine.slide_and_vend: 2.1–3.6s dead hero slides down screen leaving blood trail; both fade while vending overlaps. Clear overlay fully before release.
state_machine.emerge: 3.6–5.5s intact same hero emerges, looks left/right and shrugs.
state_machine.respawn_vend: Existing death system consumes life exactly once. After player elects continuation and lives>0, restore selected hero max health at checkpoint and run dispense-only for<=2s. At entrance with no dispenser retain existing entrance respawn.
state_machine.finish: Idempotent safe finalizer, used for natural completion, skip, watchdog or missing asset. Restore one intact hero at safe exit; clear overlays/temporary props; unlock once; retain committed checkpoint and healing.

commit_contract.check_in: At eligible first crossing, atomically commit higher checkpoint index, checkpoint_active=true, respawn x equal to3300/6660/8190 respectively with feet at440, and selected max health. Presentation uses captured pre-heal mode. Never shift saved checkpoint to machine center x+64.
commit_contract.death_respawn: Leave life debit to existing death system; this sequence neither adds nor subtracts lives. Preserve gate/kill/swarm progress exactly as existing checkpoint respawn.
commit_contract.hero_identity: Keep selected Tony/Sean, loadout and max HP; clone is presentation, not character switch or duplicate playable entity.
commit_contract.no_resurrection: Zero lives remains Game Over; dispenser cannot bypass it.
commit_contract.world_progress: Never reset level, defeated enemies, gate state, intro-played flags or prior checkpoints. Full explicit run restart uses normal reset.
commit_contract.mode_snapshot: Read alive state, health and selected max_health BEFORE restoring HP: health<max selects injured, health==max selects stamp. Store mode; never re-evaluate after healing.

simulation_lock.entry_projectiles: Remove transient damaging projectiles and active overlap hazards that would immediately hit the exit, or relocate exit to safe clear location. Do not destroy unrelated enemies or permanent hazards. Snapshot/restore all other frozen state without catch-up ticks.
simulation_lock.hero_actions: Disable move,jump,fire and interaction while locked; scripted visual motion only. Keep player collision non-damaging during presentation.
simulation_lock.release: Zero player velocity; safe floor-supported exit, no solid overlap. Resume world once; protection follows existing hurt/respawn visual rules. No queued attack burst.

skip.policy: First injured sequence plays unless watchdog intervenes; subsequent injured sequences skippable. Healthy and respawn paths are short and may also safely finalize on explicit skip.
skip.input: Use existing dialogue_skip action only, with its current keyboard/controller bindings. Snapshot held inputs on entry, require release then new just-pressed skip. Do not treat ordinary shoot/jump/confirm as skip unless already bound to dialogue_skip.
skip.effect: Jump immediately to finish; already committed HP/checkpoint retained. Clear held action/release guard so skip cannot fire, jump, pause or retrigger after release.
skip.pause: Pause during sequence freezes it, resume returns same state. Returning to main menu cancels visual state and cleans up locks without replaying intro within current run.
skip.release_guard: On finalize, block held shoot/jump/interact/skip/confirm/pause buttons until released; allow movement from current directional input. Restart/title exit clears sequence-owned audio/overlays. Do not modify global InputMap bindings.

Repeated overlap/rapid exit-entry cannot retrigger healing; older checkpoint never regresses index.

Verify visual timing and identity with permitted playtest; no screenshots or animation quality claims from headless tests.
Injured mode selected before immediate heal; healthy stamp never plays compression.
Session flag survives death/new run/hero switch, remains unset on healthy/respawn/main-menu abort, resets on app relaunch.
Preserve exact checkpoint x and feet440; decorative prop cannot block route.
Explicit Pause duration excluded from cap; sequence physics freeze does NOT freeze presentation watchdog.
Both heroes: X-eye impact, single synchronized splat, trailing blood follows slide and fades; natural/skip/watchdog/menu paths clean overlays without consuming life.
clarification: Presentation details and duration ceiling came from Storyboarding approved brief. Commit-at-entry, repeat-use policy and input details are conservative implementation defaults preserving existing checkpoint semantics.
integration_gate: Wait for Art, Audio and Mechanics deliveries; integrate runtime LAST. Do not rebuild a partial dispenser as complete.

first_full_sequence_seen.scope: Current application session, shared across Tony/Sean, checkpoints and new runs; not persisted to disk.
first_full_sequence_seen.set: On safe completion or watchdog finalization of first injured full sequence. Do not set for healthy stamp or dispense-only respawn. Main-menu abort before completion does not count as seen.
first_full_sequence_seen.reset: Only application relaunch; normal death, Retry, title return, character switch and developer run restart preserve flag.
first_full_sequence_seen.effect: First injured full sequence non-skippable but time capped; later injured sequences accept explicit skip. No new settings UI needed.

screen_impact_revision.status: Explicit user revision; Art/Audio/Engineering integration pending
screen_impact_revision.sequence: Thrown hero hits screen with blood splatter and synchronized SPLAT sound. Dead cartoon hero has X eyes, slides downward leaving a blood trail; hero and trail fade completely.
screen_impact_revision.style: Cartoon blood and X-eyed dead hero; preserve Tony/Sean identity. This replaces earlier bloodless impact direction.
screen_impact_revision.timing: Fit impact into1.4–2.1s and slide/trail fade overlapping vending2.1–3.6s; finish cleanup by control release. Existing5.5s target and7s cap unchanged.
screen_impact_revision.lives: Presentation only; no additional life loss or gameplay death handler. Replacement hero emerges as already specified.
screen_impact_revision.cleanup: On skip/watchdog/menu/restart clear body, blood splatter/trail overlays and sequence-owned sound. No persistent screen stain.
screen_impact_revision.audio: One impact SPLAT cue on impact event, optionally slide sound; do not await audio completion.

random_impact.status: Approved user revision; Engineering integration pending
random_impact.selection: Choose one random viewport-space impact center per full throw, not per frame. Reuse for trajectory endpoint, impact body, splat sound position where supported, slide and blood trail.
random_impact.bounds: Compute admissible center rectangle from actual viewport safe area inset by transformed full impact body bounds at maximum throw/impact scale, including rotation and all body layers. Include splatter extent where practical. Use actual left/top/right/bottom extents relative to anchor, not assumed centered artwork.
random_impact.safe_area: Exclude reserved top HUD band and retain a small edge margin; avoid masking lives/name HUD.
random_impact.sampling: Uniform random x and y within admissible rectangle. No requirement to avoid repeating nearby positions. Keep cosmetic randomness separate from enemy/gameplay RNG.
random_impact.fallback: If body does not fit, reduce presentation scale to fit safe region before sampling; if valid rectangle collapses, use its single valid center. Never clamp body after impact in a visible jump.
random_impact.perspective: Keep growing perspective throw; choose endpoint before animation, then interpolate from machine origin toward it. Validate largest body extent, not only starting sprite size.
random_impact.slide: Entire body must fit at impact. Subsequent intentional downward slide may leave bottom edge as gag finishes; blood trail follows sampled point and fades under existing cleanup/deadline rules.
tests: Both heroes across many seeds: full transformed impact bounds stay within safe viewport.
Maximum scale, off-center anchors and supported viewport sizes covered.
Same sampled point used by throw end, impact and slide/trail start; no mid-animation jitter.
No effect on gameplay RNG, checkpoint, lives, total timing or pause/skip cleanup.
